ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. It might have been -- let's see, maybe I was around Kansas City before '27. Yeah, I must have been moving awfully fast to play all those bands, because there was another band in there named Jack Allen. I didn't play with them, my brother was with that band. They had a gang of little bands there, since you bring it up.

Yeah, well, there was a lot of action there. And it seems as though it -- well, it had a lot to do with that -- what was it, the Pendergrast regime, things were corrupt and it's like when the Prohibition on in Harlem, there was more going on then than any other --
